 The project table provides information to help understand the projected loading schedule.  Please note that
 all times are posted in "hour ending" format.  For example, the release posted for hour 1400 would represent 
 the generation release starting at 1:00pm and continuing until 2:00pm.  The values in the projected loading 
 schedule indicate the generating capacity rate in megawatts (MW) for each project. The water discharge from 
 each project is measured in cubic feet per second (CFS).  

 Additionally, all generation releases posted above are subject to change.  There are a variety of factors that
 may require changes to the generation schedule, including, but not limited to, increased power demand, 
 transmission system constraints, unexpected generator outages, and changes in reservoir inflow.  The lake 
 numbers are also used in our Automated Voice Response (AVR) telephone system.  That system provides similar
 information to callers using a touch-tone phone.  The phone number for the AVR system is (866) 494-1993.
